Amazon's 2026 Labor Day mega sale is officially live with $50 off AirPods Pro 3, AirTag 2 still at its all-time low of $20 each. But topping today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break is Amazon's first cash discounts on the all-new M6 Mac mini and M5 Pro Mac mini, alongside an incredible Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery deal from $39, plus the 44mm Apple Watch SE 3 at its all-time low of $200. Also on tap: Anker Labor Day deals from 42% off, Bose 2026 Labor Day savings up to $320 off, and Apple's brand-new Polishing Cloth for $9 with Prime shipping before it sells out. All the top picks are waiting below.

Amazon's 2026 Labor Day mega sale is officially underway! Thousands of deals across Apple, Android, TVs, tech under $100, and even steals from $5

One of the best Apple deals of the year: brand-new 2026 AirTag 2 from just $20 each

  • AirTag 2 for $24 (regularly $29) — matching its all-time low
  • AirTag 2 four-pack for $80 (regularly $99) — new all-time low
  • AirPods Pro 3 for $200 (regularly $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 for $429 (regularly $549)
  • AirPods 4 for $99 (regularly $129)

Amazon offering launch discounts on two cheapest new M6 Mac mini models

Amazon has once again lowered the prices on the two cheapest M6 Mac mini pre-orders now that the Labor Day mega sale is officially underway, and they really want you to buy one. The discounts aren't massive, but they're the only legitimate way to get the new M6 mini for less right now. Be sure to grab an Apple Polishing Cloth for $9 with Prime shipping before it sells out.

We spotted yesterday evening that Amazon dropped the MSRPs on the 16GB/256GB entry-level model, and now the 16GB/512GB mid-tier model has joined the discounted ranks:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB for $880 (regularly $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB for $1,070 (regularly $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB for $1,299
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB for $1,669 (regularly $1,699)

These discounts seem minor because the new minis start at $899, but these things aren't even out yet (shipping starts September 22nd). If you're not planning to trade-in to get your pre-order in, saving a few bucks on gas or coffee money can't hurt.

As expected, the all-new M6 Mac mini is still full price everywhere else at other Apple Authorized Resellers and Apple itself. No sign of any deals on the 24GB M6 or the M5 Pro models just yet, but we'll be watching.

Midnight Apple Watch SE 3 drops to all-time low $200 at Amazon

Amazon's 2026 Labor Day sale is officially live, and so is the 44mm Apple Watch SE 3 at its all-time low of $200 — what just might be one of the best values across the entire current generation of Apple Watches we've tracked.

Amazon now has the Midnight 44mm Apple Watch SE 3 marked down to $199.99 shipped.

It normally retails for $280, so you're looking at nearly a 30% discount, saving you $79.

  • Midnight 44mm Apple Watch SE 3 for $200 (regularly $280)

Hurry: AirPods 4 just $80 via Amazon Renewed

iPhone 17 Pro drops to all-time low at Amazon with up to $290 off (Premium Renewed)

With the iPhone 18 Pro release date looming, Amazon has just dropped the iPhone 17 Pro to a new all-time low. If you want to skip paying full price for the new Pro series next month (which is expected to be very expensive), or wait at least half a year for an official refurb to surface, Amazon's highest-quality Renewed iPhone 17 Pro is now down up to $290 with a full year of Amazon Renewed coverage.

For now, legit Amazon Renewed Premium Listings are the best way to get your hands on an iPhone 17 Pro. Apple's official refurbished storefront doesn't have stock yet, and these are the highest quality models Amazon offers with a full year of Amazon Renewed coverage and a 90%+ battery health guarantee — not your typical refurb.

The 512GB and 1TB models are both down to the lowest prices we've tracked:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro in Cosmic Orange for $1,215 (regularly $1,499 new) — all-time low
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro in Deep Blue for $1,215 (regularly $1,499 new) — all-time low
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro in Silver for $1,208 (regularly $1,499 new) — all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro in Cosmic Orange for $1,166 (regularly $1,299 new) — all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro in Deep Blue for $1,171 (regularly $1,299 new) — all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro in Silver for $1,170 (regularly $1,299 new) — all-time low

All of the links above go to legit Amazon Renewed Premium Listings — beware of third-party sellers.

I don't know about you, but I'm really going to miss the 17 Pro's colors. I always wanted an all-black one, but I might hold out for another year.

Apple's brand-new 2026 Polishing Cloth is in stock at Amazon for $9 with Prime shipping, grab one before they sell out

ecobee 2026 Labor Day sale goes live: HomeKit thermostats, sensors and bundles up to $120 off

ecobee has officially launched its 2026 Labor Day sale at Amazon with up to $120 off across its lineup of HomeKit smart thermostats starting from $120, alongside some of the deepest discounts yet on select sensor accessories and complete security bundles.

ecobee 2026 Labor Day deals

While individual smart thermostat prices haven't necessarily dipped below Prime Day pricing, ecobee smart home gear rarely sees deep discounts. Money off is always worth a look, and these kinds of markdowns almost only happen during these seasonal sales:

  • Smart Thermostat Premium for $230 (regularly $260)

  • Smart Thermostat Essential for $120 (regularly $140)
  • Smart Doorbell Camera for $130 (regularly $160)

2026 Labor Day sale: Amazon devices up to 40% off from $18 — Echo displays/speakers, Fire TV, more

Apple's official Bumper case drops to all-time low under $13 (32% off)

August 27 update: Black Apple iPhone Air Bumper back in stock for Prime members with free shipping at $13.42 — that's 66% off MSRP.

iPhone Air users listen up, Apple's official Bumper case has dropped to its Amazon all-time low under $13 with free Prime shipping.

Amazon now has Apple's iPhone Air Bumper starting from $12.64 with free shipping for Prime members or on orders over $35.

The light blue variant is under $13, which is the lowest Amazon price we've tracked, and it's a massive 68% off the original $39 MSRP. Other colors are priced higher right now, and black has already sold out — at this price, light blue could go next.

Yes, this is just a simple Bumper that wraps around the edges of the device, but we're talking Apple-branded cases at clearance pricing. It preserves the original design feel of your device while providing decent protection for users who truly only need basic coverage — though it only protects the edges, not the screen or camera module.
